heard: The book of Luke lists the names in a row Jesus began His work about thirty years old As was supposed He was the Son of Joseph Son of Heli and Son of Matad Levi followed and Melchi and Jammai The list goes on through Joseph and Mattathias Amos and Nahum and Esli and Nagai Martha and Atathies and Simeon and Hosek Jonam is the link, the son of Eliak In between the fathers and the sons yet to come A name in the register, a part of the whole In the line of David Faithful and true
